channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Oil rises as concerns over Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia eclipse supply recovery
item.description: Iran's move to step up attacks on tankers which are transiting through the Strait of Hormuz has also led to renewed worries over oil supplies among traders.

item.title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
item.description: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes says the AI infrastructure boom is being overbuilt and is betting an eventual crash and bailout will send crypto higher.

item.title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
item.description: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.

item.title: Trump set to talk to Russia's Putin 'very soon' about plague-related death in Siberia
item.description: Trump says he will speak with Putin “very soon” over a plague incident in Russia as CDC monitor the situation.

item.title: Trump isn't ‘completely wrong’: Hormuz disruption is Asia’s problem, says Singapore's foreign minister
item.description: Trump has said that Asian economies, which are heavily reliant on energy shipped through Hormuz, should shoulder more of the burden of keeping the waterway open.

item.title: This photonics stock is already up 600% in one year. Now it's breaking out again
item.description: We have a clear breakout from a consolidation area going back to April.

item.title: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build
item.description: HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.

item.title: Trump hedges on paying back government for ads that already aired
item.description: The New York Times reported "Trump personally instructed his budget director to use taxpayer money for TV ads praising him and his presidency."

item.title: DeepSeek considers doubling latest funding round to up to $15 billion, sources say
item.description: China's DeepSeek weighs upsizing funding round to up to $14.9 billion, sources tell CNBC, and the final amount could still change in final talks.

item.title: Singapore's Temasek warns of the ‘biggest risk’ facing markets right now
item.description: Unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade poses the biggest risk to markets, according to Singapore state-owned investment giant Temasek.

item.title: Luxury developers flocked to the 'Hamptons of Hungary' — but some projects are stalling
item.description: Lake Balaton in south-west Hungary has been a popular vacation destination for decades, but average transaction prices are falling.

item.title: Russian lab worker's suspected plague death leaves experts puzzled
item.description: Russian authorities say the situation is stable and there are no reports of secondary cases.

item.title: Cramer says these blue-chip stocks are among the best ways to invest in the AI boom
item.description: Jim Cramer said established tech giants with strong businesses and multiple ways to benefit from AI are some of the best places to invest in the boom.

item.title: Student riots engulf France as far-right presidential frontrunner Le Pen vows fiscal turnaround
item.description: A teenager reportedly lost a hand in the protests, which have seen over 5,000 people arrested.

item.title: Anthropic expands Claude Startups program in bid to snag founders and fast-growing companies
item.description: The expansion marks the AI company's latest push to deepen its ties to founders and fast-growing companies.

item.title: Private credit woes aren’t dampening demand for alternatives, says Goldman Sachs Asset Management
item.description: Why investors remain happy with alternative investments, and how some opportunities are emerging in private credit, according to a leading Wall Street bank.

item.title: Rebounding oil exports through Strait of Hormuz are vulnerable to stepped-up Iranian tanker attacks
item.description: Nearly 20 commercial ships, mostly tankers, have come under attack over the past month while sailing through the Hormuz choke point.

item.title: Kalshi launches transparency features on its election contracts ahead of midterms
item.description: The platform will now provide tags that indicate which election markets have low volumes.

item.title: Emmy Awards leave broadcast TV for Prime Video in 2027 under six-year deal
item.description: The Emmy Awards will stream exclusively and free on Prime Video worldwide starting in 2027 under a six-year deal.

item.title: Salesforce shares sit at the epicenter of AI confusion. Here's how to trade it
item.description: If ever there was a stock that personified the promise and peril of the AI trade, it's Salesforce.

item.title: A new analyst call on Home Depot reflects our feeling on what to do with the stock
item.description: We're holding a small position in Home Depot to be ready for when rates eventually fall.

item.title: Shopping for a car on Amazon? Compare these auto lenders before financing
item.description: Amazon Autos offers financing through participating lenders, but shoppers should still compare auto loans to find the best rates and terms.

item.title: Young voters struggle to afford housing. But they don't expect help from political candidates
item.description: Pennsylvania's competitive U.S. House districts showcase how housing affordability challenges for young voters may play into control of the next Congress.

item.title: Meta joins with group of companies to tame ‘chaos’ of doing business with AI bots
item.description: Meta and OpenAI Chairman Bret Taylor’s startup Sierra are building a set of tech standards to make it easier to do business with AI bots.

item.title: Wednesday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: A rally in tech stocks and cooler Treasury yields lifted the S&P 500 to an all-time high and a record close on Tuesday.

item.title: How event contract bundles are boosting volume on prediction markets
item.description: Combo contracts are driving volume growth even as they make up a small, albeit consistent, share of transactions.

item.title: Russia plague: How great is the global risk? Maybe low, but infectious disease experts want more data
item.description: Uncertainty surrounds the death of an employee at a Russian anti-plague institute. Here's what infectious disease experts say about how worried you should be.

item.title: Alito plans to stay on Supreme Court, even if Democrats regain Senate: Report
item.description: Samuel Alito is one of six conservative justices on the Supreme Court, three of whom were nominated by President Donald Trump.

item.title: British Airways plans record 106-seat business class on Airbus A380 jumbo jets
item.description: British Airways is ripping out coach-class seats and building a giant premium economy and business class in a bet on the high-end travel boom.

item.title: Why deep-red Kansas has become an unexpected Senate battleground
item.description: A combination of local, national and international events has contributed to making the Kansas Senate race one to watch.
